title: itemtextframe
summary: MSUI has an authored ItemTextFrame shell: Program.GameObjects.cs DrawItemTextFrame draws the 384x512 window with the four-piece UI-ItemText-* art and minimize-style close button, filled with gameobject page text fetched via CMSG_PAGE_TEXT_QUERY (chained pages followed via the next-page id). CMSG_ITEM_TEXT_QUERY exists but only serves the mail frame's letter bodies. The reader lacks most of the reference furniture and the bag-letter route.

openItems.text: No bag-letter read route: an inventory item with ITEM_FIELD_ITEM_TEXT_ID shows the read hover cursor (InventoryUiLaw.HoverCursor) but right-click never opens the reader; Benilla opens the ItemTextFrame with the mail item-text cache
No title FontString (item/object name) or creator 'From,' line
No page navigation: MSUI concatenates all fetched pages into one view instead of Prev/Next buttons + current-page number
No material variants (Stone/Marble/Bronze corner textures, material text/title color tables) - parchment-only
CMSG_READ_ITEM / SMSG_READ_ITEM_OK multi-page book flow absent (matches registry; also a named follow-up in Benilla)
No open/close sounds (igMainMenuOpen/Close) and no ITEM_TEXT_TRANSLATION progress bar (the latter never fires in Benilla either)
Body text is drawn with the default ImGui font at a rough line-wrap estimate, not the ItemTextFontNormal (Morpheus 15) that FontObjectLaw already defines
